description: Fir Extract FIR 45/2024, PS Chhehrata at PS Chhehrata (Amritsar): Narcotics (NDPS Act)

metadata.text: [Public record · High Court of Punjab and Haryana, CRM-M-55872-2024, order dated 2025-07-08 · names pseudonymised] Facts as recorded in the order: in the FIR, on 08.03.2024, ASI [Police official O1] and his police team, acting on the basis of a secret information, apprehended two suspects namely [Person X1] alias [Person X1] and [Person X4] alias [Person X4], who were allegedly involved in heroin trafficking. Both of them were spotted on a black-grey [Name W1] without a number plate near Brother [Name W2] on GT Road, [Name W3]. Upon interception, both the individuals attempted to flee but were apprehended. After being informed of their legal rights under the NDPS Act, they opted to be searched in the presence of a gazetted officer. 2 Thereafter, Assistant Commissioner of Police arrived at the spot and completed the formalities under Section 50 of the NDPS Act. During the search, a wax-sealed envelope containing 500 grams of heroin was recovered from [Person X1]'s waist bag. The heroin, along with the [Name W1] scooter, was seized, and both the accused were booked under Sections 21(C), 29, 61, and 85 of the NDPS Act. Thereafter, on the basis of the disclosure statement made by co-accused [Person X1], the petitioner has been nominated in the FIR (supra). Court proceedings: petition for regular bail by [Accused A1]; outcome: Allowed.
